LANE 7 ARM_0: the four gates that must pass before the memo keying merges.

The change in language.py touches EVERY forward of the shipped path, so the merge
into glm5-serve-unified is held on these. They are about not breaking the
single-stream world and are independent of whether overlap wins.

  A1  bit-exact vs single-stream at B=1 (token ids AND final logits)
  A2  no per-token latency regression at N=1, lag=1 (median <=2%, p95 <=5%)
  A3  mixed-shape two-channel correctness vs per-channel serial references
  A4  no memo growth over 500 single-stream steps (exactly one entry per layer)

A4 exists because Stream equality is IDENTITY-based: if the key were ever derived
from a Stream OBJECT rather than a value, every step would mint a new entry and
the memo would grow without bound while never hitting.

A4_no_memo_growth.rule: 500 single-stream steps must add ZERO new entries and zero new keys

first_use_compile_cost.note: one-time per NEW stream key; warm each channel before serving on it

ARM_0_VERDICT: ALL FOUR GATES PASS - safe to merge the memo keying
